name: Logic Assistant
description: Adds an AI-powered Suggest logic assistant to REDCap's logic editor, using the GenAI service configured for the project. Describe what you need in plain language and the module suggests branching logic, a calculation, a report filter, or ASI/alert logic, built from the project's own fields, events and repeating instruments. Only project metadata is sent to the AI service; no record data is ever sent. Suggestions are validated before they are shown and are never applied automatically.

system-settings.name:
AI service
The module uses whichever GenAI service is configured at the system level, or the project's override if one is set. If GenAI isn't enabled for a project, the assistant does not appear.
Only show the assistant to users with Project Design and Setup rights

Maximum characters of project metadata sent per request
Default 60000. On large projects, field detail is cut down to fit.

Daily AI token limit for the whole site
The total tokens (input and output) the Logic Assistant may use per day across all projects, resetting at midnight server time. Applies alongside the per-project limit below. Leave blank or enter 0 for no limit.

Daily AI token limit per project
The total tokens (input and output) each project may use per day, resetting at midnight server time. Leave blank or enter 0 for no limit. Super users can override this for individual projects.

project-settings.name:
Project-specific guidance for the assistant (optional)
e.g. naming conventions, or 'Missing data is coded as -99'. This is added to every request from this project.

Daily AI token limit for this project (super users only)
Overrides the system-level per-project limit for this project. Leave blank to use the system limit; enter 0 for no per-project limit. The site-wide limit still applies.
